title: Valet Parking Complaint
categories: Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns
description: Use this service request to report a complaint regarding valet services at a location or a valet company. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 2 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: What is the business name for the complaint?
What is the name of the valet company?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a valet parking company or service.
actions.why: For a complaint about valet parking at a location or about a valet company. The 311 request form asks for the business name and allows the company name and a description of the complaint.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Valet Parking Complaint"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Parking, Vehicle, Bicycle and Scooter Concerns" > Choose "Valet Parking Complaint"
